description:
The Velo Orange Rando frameset features a modernized geometry, fit, and finish that makes for an absolutely sublime all-day and all-night lightweight adventurer and road bike.
The geometry has been designed to feature a road-endurance spec, which is more consistent with the fit of many modern road bikes. The frame features thoughtfully selected double-butted, thin-wall chromoly tubes, and a wishbone seat cluster arrangement which offers a light, springy, and supple ride that will keep you feeling fresh as the road fade behind you.
The fork features a graceful and elegant French-style bend that maintains a timeless aesthetic while absorbing the perfect amount of road chatter.
Perhaps the most unique and exciting aspect of this frameset is its modular dropout system! Every Rando will ship with two sets of dropout inserts, which are attached to the rear end by supplied stainless steel hardware:
(1) set of vertical dropouts for standard rim brake rear wheels spaced at 130mm
(1) set of rear-facing dropouts spaced at 120mm for standard track wheels
This system allows riders to select and swap out their drivetrains for any number of configurations on the fly! You could be riding the Rando with wireless 12spd road gear one minute and easily have the bike converted into a brakeless fixie within the hour! We've found the options to be endless, and we believe you will too.
And finally the paint. We currently offer 3 colors:

Bonfire Fade - a gorgeous, throwback head turner that fades from red to yellow.

Night Sky - dark grey with layers and layers of metallic flakes, just like when you look up at the sky when you're away from light pollution.

Brook Trout - a stunning combination of greens, golds, browns, and hints of red which coalesce into a symphony of beautiful metallics. This color is being discontinued and does not have the monostay rack mount or double eyelets on the fork ends.

Here are the specifications you or your mechanic need to know:

Tire Clearance: Ideally designed for 700x32 tires. 700cx35 MAX using vertical dropouts, 700x38 MAX using rear-facing dropouts. 700x25mm with 38mm fenders.

Frame Eyelets: Single eyelets on rear dropouts for fenders, rack mount on monostay

Fork Eyelets: Hourglass braze-on for front racks like a Rando style rack or one of our Flat Pack Rack.

*** Please note, if you are purchasing this frame, and wish to have a bottom bracket or headset pressed in, you will need to navigate here to add the installation charge to your cart before checking out. We'll handle the rest!***
